brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent considering childproofing but unsure how to get started with installation. Use the available support claim without inventing ease, tools, compatibility or installation time.

variants.primary_text: A cabinet lock in your hand and no idea where to start? The Peach Bucket is a six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes, with 1-to-1 installation video support. If you're unsure how to install the pieces, you can get guidance instead of working it out alone. Childproofing does not replace adult supervision.
variants.headline: Childproofing kit with 1-to-1 video support

variants.primary_text: Socket guards and door guards are different parts to install, and it can be hard to know what to do first. The Peach Bucket kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can get guidance as you work through installation. It is made for childproofing Indian homes. Adult supervision is still necessary.
variants.headline: Get installation support for the six-part kit

variants.concept: Support is part of the kit
variants.primary_text: When a cabinet lock is sitting on the counter, you may still wonder how to install it. The Peach Bucket includes 1-to-1 installation video support with its six-part childproofing kit. That means installation guidance is part of the offer, along with edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. Adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: A childproofing kit with installation video support

internal_notes: The copy uses the supplied 1-to-1 installation video support claim without adding claims about setup time, tools, compatibility, or results.
Adult supervision is stated in each variant. No total safety claim is made.

The money-back and eligible-failure replacement guarantees are omitted because policy eligibility details were not supplied. Price and prepaid savings are not relevant to this installation-focused brief.
